mode.tooltip: Non-24 wrap-around uses normal-length hours and wraps at the Non-24 day length (so it may show values above 24). Mars-style stretches/compresses the hours so the day always reads 0-24.

planet.tooltip: Use the length of a day (sunrise to sunrise) on a planet of the solar system, or Custom to use the day length typed below. Calculated from IAU/JPL rotation and orbital periods; Mars is the official sol. The gas giants have no solid surface, so their figures depend on how rotation is measured (see the README); use Custom for other values.

day-length.description: Custom day length (hours, h:mm or h:mm:ss)
day-length.tooltip: Used when the preset above is Custom. Real time in one Non-24 day, at least 1 hour. Decimal hours (24.5), hours:minutes (24:30, or 24:30.5 for fractional minutes), or hours:minutes:seconds (24:39:35.244 for fractional seconds). A comma works as the decimal separator. Applied when you stop typing; the clock keeps its current position in the day.

show-real.description: Show Earth time (local clock with UTC offset)

set-time-text.tooltip: Entered in the units of the current display mode: 0-24 in Mars-style, normal hours up to the day length in wrap-around.

set-time-button.description: Set clock to this time now

sync-seconds.description: Wrap-around: sync seconds with the Earth clock when setting HH:MM
sync-seconds.tooltip: Setting HH:MM then gives HH:MM:SS where SS is the Earth clock's seconds. Typing HH:MM:SS sets exactly that. Stays in sync across Non-24 midnight only if the day length is a whole number of minutes.

align-button.description: Wrap-around: align seconds with the Earth clock now (at most 30 s change)

font-family.tooltip: DSEG fonts need to be installed (sudo apt install fonts-dseg).

custom-font.description: Custom font family (overrides the choice above)
custom-font.tooltip: Any installed font family name, e.g. DSEG14 Modern. Leave empty to use the list.

show-unlit.tooltip: Draws the segments that are off as a faint ghost behind the digits.

shape-zero-slashed.tooltip: Off draws a plain 0 without the diagonal. The digit shapes need DSEG v0.50 or newer (the Braille segment glyphs); older fonts show standard digits.
